verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch's docs state it can combine full-text search, structured filters, and aggregations 'in one engine' (elastic-docs-4), which is the technical basis for faceted navigation (filtering + counts), but the evidence pack contains no explicit walkthrough of terms/range/histogram aggregations, filter aggregations, or an example of building a faceted-search query with live counts. Missing for 10: dedicated docs/tutorial on aggregations for faceting (terms, range, histogram), a worked example combining filters+aggs in a single query, and independent/hands-on corroboration that this pattern works as advertised.
